label: strlen
brief: Returns the length of a string.
description: The strlen function returns the number of characters in a string.

parameters.name: input
parameters.description: The string whose length is to be measured.

returns.description: The length of the provided string.

notes: This function counts all characters, including spaces and special characters.

label: array_push
brief: Pushes one or more elements onto the end of an array.
description: The array_push function appends elements to the end of an array and returns the new length of the array.

parameters.name: array
parameters.description: The array to which elements will be added.

parameters.name: elements
parameters.description: One or more elements to add to the array.

returns.description: The new length of the array after elements have been added.

notes: This function modifies the original array.
